Node.Text: The boxes above have been drawn using semitransparent pen color. The additional drawing consists of the frame around each of the boxes, which is drawn after the initial painting.
The ellipse above uses full custom draw to present concentric circles, and the box consists of a textured semitransparent image and gray, textured semitransparent shadow.
The boxes above have custom draw shadows only. The shadows are drawn black with radial gradient.
